    function esc(str) { return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (m) { return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[m]; }); }
    function root() { return document.getElementById('app'); }
    function allGenreNames() { return Array.from(new Set(genres.flatMap(function (g) { return g.items; }).concat(compactGenres))); }
    function keyLabel(code) { return state.keyVariant === 'camelot' ? code : classicKeys[code] || code; }
    function selectedKeys() { return Array.from(state.keys.entries()).filter(function (item) { return item[1] === true; }).map(function (item) { return item[0]; }); }
    function excludedKeys() { return Array.from(state.keys.entries()).filter(function (item) { return item[1] === false; }).map(function (item) { return item[0]; }); }

    function render() {
      const app = root();
      app.className = 'jp-filter' + (state.open ? ' is-open' : '') + (state.advanced ? ' is-advanced' : '');
      app.innerHTML = renderTop() + renderBody() + renderContains() + renderKeyModal();
      bind();
      applyKeyActiveState();
      updateSliderCss();
      enhanceScrollable();
    }

    function renderTop() {
      return '<div class="jp-filter__top">' +
        '<div class="table-title"><div class="table-title__row"><h2 class="release-title">Новые релизы</h2></div></div>' +
        '<div class="top-controls">' +
          '<div class="track-settings"><div class="track-settings__inner">' +
            '<button class="track-settings__item ' + (state.mode === 'downloaded' ? 'active' : '') + '" data-action="mode" data-mode="downloaded" style="color:' + (state.mode === 'downloaded' ? 'var(--color-feature-biloba-400)' : 'var(--color-text-secondary)') + '">' + icons.eyeOn + '<span class="track-settings__text">Скачанное</span></button>' +
            '<button class="track-settings__item ' + (state.mode === 'listened' ? 'active' : '') + '" data-action="mode" data-mode="listened" style="color:' + (state.mode === 'listened' ? 'var(--color-feature-biloba-400)' : 'var(--color-text-secondary)') + '">' + icons.eyeOff + '<span class="track-settings__text">Прослушанное</span></button>' +
          '</div></div>' +
          '<button class="pro-filter-button ' + (state.advanced ? 'active' : '') + '" data-action="toggle-advanced"><span class="tooltip">' + icons.info + '</span><span class="pro-filter-button__text">Продвинутый фильтр</span><span class="toggle"><span class="toggle__track"></span><span class="toggle__knob"></span></span></button>' +
          '<div class="filter-button ' + (state.open ? 'active' : '') + '"><button class="button-pill" data-action="toggle-open">' + icons.filter + '<span class="button-pill__text">Фильтр</span>' + (state.open ? icons.arrowUp : icons.arrowDown) + '</button></div>' +
          '<div class="date-pill">' + icons.calendar + '<span class="date-pill__text">04.06.24</span></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    function renderBody() {
      return '<div class="filter-body"><div class="compact-body">' + renderCompactBody() + '</div><div class="advanced-body">' + renderAdvancedBody() + '</div></div>';
    }

    function renderCompactBody() {
      return renderGenresStrip() + '<div class="middle-row">' + renderTags() + renderBpm() + '</div>';
    }

    function renderGenresStrip() {
      const filter = state.search.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '');
      const items = compactGenres.filter(function (item) { return item.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '').includes(filter); });
      const search = state.searchOpen
        ? '<div class="search-input-wrap">' + icons.search + '<input class="search-input" value="' + esc(state.search) + '" data-role="search" placeholder="Поиск по жанрам" /><button type="button" data-action="clear-search" aria-label="Очистить поиск">' + icons.close + '</button></div>'
        : '<button class="search-icon" data-action="open-search" aria-label="Открыть поиск">' + icons.search + '</button>';
      return '<div class="genres-component ' + (state.searchOpen ? 'search-opened' : '') + '">' + search +
        '<div class="genres-scroll" data-scrollable="x">' + items.map(function (item) { return '<button class="genre-chip ' + genreClass(item) + '" data-action="genre" data-value="' + esc(item) + '">' + esc(item) + '</button>'; }).join('') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="scroll-fader left"></div><div class="scroll-fader right"></div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    function genreClass(item) {
      if (state.selected.has(item)) return 'positive';
      if (state.excluded.has(item)) return 'negative';
      return '';
    }

    function renderTags() {
      return '<div class="tags-group" data-scrollable="x">' + markerData.map(function (item) {
        const name = item[0];
        const color = item[1];
        const value = state.markers.get(name);
        const cls = value === true ? 'active' : value === false ? 'excluded' : '';
        const bg = value === true ? ' style="background:' + color + ';outline-color:' + color + '"' : '';
        return '<button class="tag-chip ' + cls + '" data-action="marker" data-value="' + esc(name) + '"' + bg + '><span style="color:' + color + '">' + esc(name) + '</span></button>';
      }).join('') + '</div>';
    }

    function renderBpm() {
      return '<div class="bpm">' +
        '<div class="bpm-inputs">' +
          '<label class="bpm-input"><span class="bpm-label">BPM Min.</span><input class="bpm-field" data-role="bpm-min-field" value="' + state.bpmMin + '" type="number" min="0" max="200"></label>' +
          '<div class="bpm-sep">—</div>' +
          '<label class="bpm-input"><span class="bpm-label">BPM Max.</span><input class="bpm-field" data-role="bpm-max-field" value="' + state.bpmMax + '" type="number" min="0" max="200"></label>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="bpm-slider" data-role="slider">' +
          '<div class="slider-scale"><span class="scale-value">0</span><span class="slider-tip" data-role="tip">' + state.bpmMax + '</span><span class="scale-value">200</span></div>' +
          '<div class="slider-control" data-role="slider-control"><span class="rail-base"></span><span class="rail-white"></span><span class="rail-active"></span><span class="handle handle-min" data-handle="min"></span><span class="handle handle-max" data-handle="max"></span></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="rating-wrap"><div class="stars">' + [1,2,3,4,5].map(function (n) { return '<button class="star ' + (state.rating >= n ? 'active' : '') + '" data-action="rating" data-rating="' + n + '">' + icons.star + '</button>'; }).join('') + '</div><button class="top15" data-action="rating" data-rating="6"><span>Топ 15</span><span class="crown ' + (state.top ? 'active' : '') + '">' + icons.crown + '</span></button></div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    function renderAdvancedBody() {
      function renderGenreCard(group) {
        return '<div class="genre-card"><p class="genre-card__title">' + esc(group.title) + '</p><div class="genre-card__chips">' + group.items.map(function (item) { return '<button class="genre-chip ' + genreClass(item) + '" data-action="genre" data-value="' + esc(item) + '">' + esc(item) + '</button>'; }).join('') + '</div></div>';
      }

      const topGenres = genres.slice(0, 3);
      const bottomGenres = genres.slice(3, 7);

      return '<div class="advanced-genres">' +
        '<div class="advanced-row advanced-row--top">' + topGenres.map(renderGenreCard).join('') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="advanced-row advanced-row--bottom">' + bottomGenres.map(renderGenreCard).join('') + '</div>' +
      '</div><div class="middle-row">' + renderTags() + renderBpm() + '</div><div class="advanced-extra"><div class="panel-card"><p class="panel-title">Тип трека</p><div class="checks">' + renderChecks(state.trackType,'track-type') + '</div></div><div class="panel-card"><p class="panel-title">Часть ночи</p><div class="checks">' + renderChecks(state.night,'night') + '</div></div><button class="panel-card key" data-action="key-popup"><div><p class="panel-title">Ключ</p><div class="check">' + (state.keyVariant === 'camelot' ? 'Камелот' : 'Классический') + '</div><div class="key-selected">' + selectedKeys().map(keyLabel).join(', ') + '</div></div><div class="key-mini">' + icons.keyMini + '</div></button></div>';
    }

    function renderChecks(map, action) {
      return Array.from(map.entries()).map(function (entry) {
        const name = entry[0];
        const value = entry[1];
        return '<button class="check ' + (value === true ? 'active' : value === false ? 'negative' : '') + '" data-action="' + action + '" data-value="' + esc(name) + '"><span class="check-box">' + (value === true ? icons.check : value === false ? '—' : '') + '</span><span>' + esc(name) + '</span></button>';
      }).join('');
    }

    function renderContains() {
      const groups = containsGroups();
      if (!groups.length) return '';
      return '<div class="contains"><div class="contains-line" data-scrollable="x">' + groups.map(function (g) {
        return '<button class="filter-component" data-action="drop" data-id="' + g.id + '"><span class="filter-component__title">' + esc(g.title) + '</span><span class="filter-component__value">' + esc(g.value) + '</span>' + (g.count ? '<span class="filter-component__count">+' + g.count + '</span>' : '') + icons.close + '</button>';
      }).join('') + '</div><div class="reset-row"><button class="reset-button" data-action="reset">' + icons.close + '<span>Сбросить</span></button></div></div>';
    }

    function summarizeTags(tags) {
      return { value: tags.slice(0,2).join(', '), count: tags.length > 2 ? tags.length - 2 : 0 };
    }

    function containsGroups() {
      const groups = [];
      const allGenres = new Set(allGenreNames());
      const excludedGenres = Array.from(state.excluded).filter(function (name) { return allGenres.has(name); });
      const excludedMarkers = Array.from(state.markers.entries()).filter(function (entry) { return entry[1] === false; }).map(function (entry) { return entry[0]; });
      const selectedGenres = Array.from(state.selected);
      const selectedMarkers = Array.from(state.markers.entries()).filter(function (entry) { return entry[1] === true; }).map(function (entry) { return entry[0]; });
      const selectedTypes = Array.from(state.trackType.entries()).filter(function (entry) { return entry[1] === true; }).map(function (entry) { return entry[0]; });
      const selectedNight = Array.from(state.night.entries()).filter(function (entry) { return entry[1] === true; }).map(function (entry) { return entry[0]; });
      const selectedKeyList = selectedKeys().map(keyLabel);
      const excludedKeyList = excludedKeys().map(keyLabel);
      if (excludedGenres.length) { const s = summarizeTags(excludedGenres); groups.push({id:'excluded-genres', title:'Искл. жанры:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (excludedMarkers.length) { const s = summarizeTags(excludedMarkers); groups.push({id:'excluded-markers', title:'Искл. теги:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (selectedGenres.length) { const s = summarizeTags(selectedGenres); groups.push({id:'genres', title:'Жанры:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (selectedMarkers.length) { const s = summarizeTags(selectedMarkers); groups.push({id:'markers', title:'Теги:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (state.bpmMin !== 0 || state.bpmMax !== 200) groups.push({id:'bpm', title:'BPM:', value: state.bpmMin + '-' + state.bpmMax});
      if (state.rating) groups.push({id:'rating', title:'Рейтинг:', value: String(state.rating)});
      if (state.top) groups.push({id:'top', title:'Рейтинг:', value:'Топ'});
      if (selectedTypes.length) { const s = summarizeTags(selectedTypes); groups.push({id:'type', title:'Тип:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (selectedNight.length) { const s = summarizeTags(selectedNight); groups.push({id:'night', title:'Часть ночи:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (excludedKeyList.length) { const s = summarizeTags(excludedKeyList); groups.push({id:'excluded-key', title:'Искл. ключ:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      if (selectedKeyList.length) { const s = summarizeTags(selectedKeyList); groups.push({id:'key', title:'Ключ:', value:s.value, count:s.count}); }
      return groups;
    }

    function renderKeyModal() {
      if (!state.keyPopup) return '';
      return '<div class="key-modal-backdrop" data-action="key-close"><div class="key-modal" data-stop="true"><div class="key-modal__head"><h3 class="key-modal__title">Ключ</h3><button class="key-modal__close" data-action="key-close">' + icons.close + '</button></div><button class="key-switch ' + (state.keyVariant === 'classic' ? 'is-classic' : '') + '" data-action="key-variant"><span class="' + (state.keyVariant === 'camelot' ? 'active' : '') + '">Camelot</span><span class="toggle"><span class="toggle__track"></span><span class="toggle__knob" style="left:' + (state.keyVariant === 'camelot' ? '2px' : '22px') + '"></span></span><span class="' + (state.keyVariant === 'classic' ? 'active' : '') + '">Классический</span></button><div class="key-wheel">' + renderKeyWheel() + '</div><div class="key-modal__description"><b>Колесо Камелота</b><p>Поможет определить, какие тональности сочетаются между собой. Для максимально чистого звучания сводите треки в одной тональности<span> (7А + 7А)</span>. Сведение с соседними значениями <span>(7А + 6А, 7А + 7B)</span> создаст мягкий музыкальный переход. Если хотите поднять или, наоборот, сбить энергию на танцполе, поменяйте 3 цифры и букву <span>(7A + 4B, 7A + 10B)</span>.</p></div><div class="key-modal__buttons"><button class="key-modal__button secondary" data-action="key-close">Отмена</button><button class="key-modal__button primary" data-action="key-close">Применить</button></div></div></div>';
    }

    function renderKeyWheel() {
      const segments = keySegments.map(function (segment) {
        const value = state.keys.get(segment.code);
        const label = keyLabel(segment.code);
        const stateClass = value === true ? ' active' : value === false ? ' excluded' : '';
        const wideClass = label.length > 2 ? ' key-wheel-text--wide' : '';
        return '<g class="key-segment' + stateClass + '" data-action="key-toggle" data-key="' + segment.code + '" aria-label="' + keyLabel(segment.code) + '" aria-pressed="' + (value === true ? 'true' : 'false') + '" tabindex="0" role="button"><path class="key-sector key-sector--' + segment.ring + '" d="' + segment.d + '"></path><text class="key-wheel-text key-wheel-text--' + segment.ring + wideClass + '" data-key-text="' + segment.code + '" x="' + segment.x + '" y="' + segment.y + '">' + esc(label) + '</text></g>';
      }).join('');
      return '<svg class="key-wheel-svg" viewBox="0 0 273.36 273.36" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' + segments + '<circle class="key-wheel-center" cx="136.68" cy="136.68" r="35.6"></circle></svg>';
    }

    function applyKeyActiveState() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.key-segment[data-key]').forEach(function (el) {
        const value = state.keys.get(el.dataset.key);
        el.classList.toggle('active', value === true);
        el.classList.toggle('excluded', value === false);
        el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', value === true ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.key-wheel-text[data-key-text]').forEach(function (el) {
        const value = state.keys.get(el.dataset.keyText);
        el.classList.toggle('active', value === true);
        el.classList.toggle('excluded', value === false);
      });
    }

    function bind() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-stop="true"]').forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener('click', function (event) { event.stopPropagation(); }); });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
          const action = el.dataset.action;
          if (action === 'toggle-open') state.open = !state.open;
          if (action === 'toggle-advanced') state.advanced = !state.advanced;
          if (action === 'mode') state.mode = el.dataset.mode;
          if (action === 'open-search') state.searchOpen = true;
          if (action === 'clear-search') { state.search = ''; state.searchOpen = true; }
          if (action === 'genre') cycleGenre(el.dataset.value);
          if (action === 'marker') cycleMap(state.markers, el.dataset.value);
          if (action === 'rating') { const n = Number(el.dataset.rating); if (n === 6) state.top = !state.top; else state.rating = state.rating === n ? 0 : n; }
          if (action === 'track-type') cycleMap(state.trackType, el.dataset.value);
          if (action === 'night') cycleMap(state.night, el.dataset.value);
          if (action === 'drop') dropGroup(el.dataset.id);
          if (action === 'reset') resetState();
          if (action === 'key-popup') state.keyPopup = true;
          if (action === 'key-close') state.keyPopup = false;
          if (action === 'key-toggle') cycleKey(el.dataset.key);
          if (action === 'key-clear') state.keys.forEach(function (_, key) { state.keys.set(key, undefined); });
          if (action === 'key-variant') state.keyVariant = state.keyVariant === 'camelot' ? 'classic' : 'camelot';
          render();
        });
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.key-segment').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
          if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
            event.preventDefault();
            el.click();
          }
        });
      });
      const search = document.querySelector('[data-role="search"]');
      if (search) {
        search.focus();
        search.setSelectionRange(search.value.length, search.value.length);
        search.addEventListener('input', function (event) { state.search = event.target.value; render(); });
        search.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) { if (event.key === 'Escape') { state.searchOpen = false; state.search = ''; render(); } });
      }
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-role="bpm-min-field"]').forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener('change', function (event) { state.bpmMin = clamp(Number(event.target.value), 0, Math.min(199, state.bpmMax - 1)); render(); }); });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-role="bpm-max-field"]').forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener('change', function (event) { state.bpmMax = clamp(Number(event.target.value), Math.max(1, state.bpmMin + 1), 200); render(); }); });
      bindSlider();
    }

    function bindSlider() {
      const control = document.querySelector('[data-role="slider-control"]');
      if (!control) return;
      let activeHandle = null;
      function setFromClient(clientX) {
        const rect = control.getBoundingClientRect();
        const pct = clamp((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width, 0, 1);
        const value = Math.round(pct * 200);
        if (!activeHandle) activeHandle = Math.abs(value - state.bpmMin) <= Math.abs(value - state.bpmMax) ? 'min' : 'max';
        if (activeHandle === 'min') state.bpmMin = clamp(value, 0, state.bpmMax - 1);
        if (activeHandle === 'max') state.bpmMax = clamp(value, state.bpmMin + 1, 200);
        render();
      }
      control.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const handle = event.target.closest('[data-handle]');
        activeHandle = handle ? handle.dataset.handle : null;
        setFromClient(event.clientX);
        function move(e) { setFromClient(e.clientX); }
        function up() { activeHandle = null; document.removeEventListener('pointermove', move); document.removeEventListener('pointerup', up); }
        document.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
        document.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
      });
    }

    function cycleGenre(name) {
      if (state.selected.has(name)) { state.selected.delete(name); state.excluded.add(name); }
      else if (state.excluded.has(name)) state.excluded.delete(name);
      else state.selected.add(name);
    }
    function cycleMap(map, name) { const v = map.get(name); map.set(name, v === undefined ? true : v === true ? false : undefined); }
    function cycleKey(code) { const value = state.keys.get(code); state.keys.set(code, value === undefined ? true : value === true ? false : undefined); }
    function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Number.isFinite(v) ? v : min)); }
    function dropGroup(id) {
      if (id === 'excluded-genres') state.excluded.clear();
      if (id === 'excluded-markers') state.markers.forEach(function (v, key) { if (v === false) state.markers.set(key, undefined); });
      if (id === 'genres') state.selected.clear();
      if (id === 'markers') state.markers.forEach(function (v, key) { if (v === true) state.markers.set(key, undefined); });
      if (id === 'bpm') { state.bpmMin = 0; state.bpmMax = 200; }
      if (id === 'rating') state.rating = 0;
      if (id === 'top') state.top = false;
      if (id === 'type') state.trackType.forEach(function (_, key) { state.trackType.set(key, undefined); });
      if (id === 'night') state.night.forEach(function (_, key) { state.night.set(key, undefined); });
      if (id === 'excluded-key') state.keys.forEach(function (v, key) { if (v === false) state.keys.set(key, undefined); });
      if (id === 'key') state.keys.forEach(function (v, key) { if (v === true) state.keys.set(key, undefined); });
    }
    function resetState() {
      state.selected.clear();
      state.excluded.clear();
      state.rating = 0;
      state.top = false;
      state.bpmMin = 0;
      state.bpmMax = 200;
      state.search = '';
      state.searchOpen = false;
      state.markers = new Map(markerData.map(function (item) { return [item[0], undefined]; }));
      state.trackType.forEach(function (_, key) { state.trackType.set(key, undefined); });
      state.night.forEach(function (_, key) { state.night.set(key, undefined); });
      state.keys.forEach(function (_, key) { state.keys.set(key, undefined); });
    }
    function updateSliderCss() {
      const slider = document.querySelector('.bpm-slider');
      if (!slider) return;
      const minPct = state.bpmMin / 200 * 100;
      const maxPct = state.bpmMax / 200 * 100;
      const active = slider.querySelector('.rail-active');
      if (active) { active.style.left = minPct + '%'; active.style.width = (maxPct - minPct) + '%'; }
      const minHandle = slider.querySelector('.handle-min');
      if (minHandle) minHandle.style.left = minPct + '%';
      const maxHandle = slider.querySelector('.handle-max');
      if (maxHandle) maxHandle.style.left = maxPct + '%';
      const tip = slider.querySelector('[data-role="tip"]');
      if (tip) tip.style.left = maxPct + '%';
    }
    function enhanceScrollable() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-scrollable="x"]').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('wheel', function (event) {
          if (Math.abs(event.deltaY) > Math.abs(event.deltaX)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            el.scrollLeft += event.deltaY;
          }
        }, { passive: false });
        let down = false;
        let startX = 0;
        let startScroll = 0;
        el.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (event) {
          down = true;
          startX = event.clientX;
          startScroll = el.scrollLeft;
          el.classList.add('is-dragging');
        });
        el.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
          if (!down) return;
          el.scrollLeft = startScroll - (event.clientX - startX);
        });
        el.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { down = false; el.classList.remove('is-dragging'); });
        el.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { down = false; el.classList.remove('is-dragging'); });
      });
    }
    render();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
